description: Comprehensive enterprise AI engineering cohort covering LLMs, RAG pipelines, Vector DBs, Prompt Engineering, Autonomous AI Agents, MCP, Fine-Tuning, and Production MLOps.

topics.objectives: Understand transformer architecture, self-attention mechanisms, and foundation LLM capabilities.
Master Chain-of-Thought, ReAct prompting, zero-shot/few-shot techniques, and structured JSON extraction.
Generate dense vector embeddings, measure cosine similarity, distance metrics, and dimensionality reduction.
Manage BPE tokenization, tiktoken counting, context truncation, and cost optimization.
Index high-dimensional vectors, set up namespaces, HNSW indexing, and payload metadata filtering.
Implement semantic chunking, recursive text splitting, multi-modal PDF parsing, and metadata enrichment.
Build end-to-end RAG architecture with dense retrieval, context synthesis, and source attribution.

topics.topic: Advanced RAG: Hybrid Search & Cohere Reranking
topics.objectives: Combine BM25 sparse keyword search with dense vector search; apply Cohere rerankers to improve precision.
Implement HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings), query rewriting, multi-query expansion, and sub-question breakdown.
Build tool-calling agents with Custom Tools, Memory, and execution loop error handling.

topics.topic: Autonomous AI Agents & Tool Execution Loops
topics.objectives: Design Plan-and-Solve agents, AutoGPT-style execution loops, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
Construct stateful multi-agent graphs with state nodes, conditional routing edges, and checkpointing.
Implement standardized MCP Client/Server interfaces for connecting LLMs to external databases and agent tools.
Process vision-language models for chart/diagram analysis and Whisper audio transcription.
Prepare instruction datasets, train LoRA adapters, quantization, and evaluate loss curves.
Set up Ragas RAG evaluation metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevance) and NeMo Guardrails against prompt injection.
Containerize FastAPI backend services with Docker, set up CI/CD pipelines, and cloud hosting.
Architect scalable enterprise multi-agent RAG system with failover, monitoring, and telemetry.
Present technical system architecture, code walkthrough, and live technical defense.
